exposure: patients who achieved pregnancy after surgery
patients who did not achieve pregnancy after surgery
outcome: changes in serum anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) levels
cohort: 233 patients with endometriomas and 57 patients with non-endometrioma ovarian cysts admitted to the Peking Union Medical College Hospital between January 2018 and September 2023.
finding: Laparoscopic removal of endometriomas, especially bilateral cysts and in cases with advanced endometriosis, can negatively impact ovarian reserve, as evidenced by decreased AMH levels; however, this decrease does not necessarily indicate a decline in fertility.
